newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslav 96 GDP up preliminary 75.9 pct vs 1995.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav 96 GDP up preliminary 75.9 pct vs 1995.

text.p: The Federal Statistics Office issued the following first preliminary Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and Gross National Porduct (GNP) figures for 1996 (in billions of dinars):
NOTES -- Preliminary figures are based on data from companies' annual balance sheets and estimated value of production in private firms and agricultural farms.
The calculation is based on a single methodology for all of Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro.
